content:
Pat D: Quick UX check — in the alert preview the channels list reads newest-first but our routing doc expects priority-first. noticed odd order when a policy has email, pager, slack. :thinking: Sarah M: I saw that too. the preview sorts by updated_at which is confusing for users expecting channel priority. Mike L: Accessibility flag: screenreader reads the list in DOM order, so we need visual and a11y parity. Pat D: Agree. two options: 1) show priority order (highest -> lowest) in preview, or 2) show the actual send order from the runtime and label it clearly. which feels less surprising? Elaine K: Backend currently returns routes in dispatch order (which can include fallbacks). changing that would be a breaking behavior for some customers. Sarah M: If we can't change API easily, we should add a header: "Dispatch order (first sent -> last)" — and let users reorder via priority UI elsewhere. Mike L: For SR users, we should announce: "Alert will be sent to X, then Y, then Z" rather than generic "3 channels". use aria-live polite and a concise sentence. Pat D: +1 to explicit announce. proposed copy: "This alert will notify: PagerDuty, Slack, Email — in that order." Thoughts on punctuation? Sarah M: That's good. maybe use em dashes for pauses? I think commas are clearer for SR. keep it short. Elaine K: Also a technical nit — preview currently hides suppressed channels. Should preview show suppressed channels greyed out or omit them? ops expects admins to confirm suppression state. Mike L: Greyed-out and annotated with "suppressed until " is best for discoverability. ensure contrast meets AA. Pat D: UX ask: add a small pill that shows priority number and an accessible label: e.g., 1 + priority one. Sarah M: Can we get a tiny mock? I'll sketch and post. Elaine K: Backend can include a "render_order" field in the route response as a short-term fix. we can map that to what preview shows. ops-bot: Deployment note: design change needs console flag toggle. see: https://go/redwood/design/alert-preview-ordering for the doc. Mike L: Quick aria snippet we can reuse: ```
This alert will notify: PagerDuty, then Slack, then Email.
``` Pat D: Perfect. last thing: keyboard focus. when you tab into the preview pane, focus should land on the announce text so SRs hear it immediately. Sarah M: Agreed. also add a "why this order" tooltip linked to routing docs. short copy: "Order reflects runtime dispatch; suppressed channels are greyed." Elaine K: I'll follow up with a tiny API spec change and rollback plan in the doc. Pat D: Thanks — i'll make a mini mock and update the console copy. tagging @Sarah M for review when done. :thumbsup:
